intended_object: The closed unit square [0,1]² ⊂ ℝ², the closed fundamental cell of the lattice ℤ² that the 2D periodic (Fourier–Galerkin) setting uses. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: `Vec 2` is `Fin 2 → ℝ`. The body is `Set.pi univ (fun _ => Icc 0 1)`, the set of points whose two coordinates both lie in [0,1]. That is exactly the closed unit square, so it matches the docstring. The definition is also equal to `Set.Icc 0 1` in the product order, by Mathlib's `Set.pi_univ_Icc`. It names one specific set inside the library's 2D periodic setup, the dimension the surrounding Galerkin construction works in. A specific object like this is not too narrow just because it is specific. Mathlib has no named definition of the unit cell; the closest thing is the general `Set.pi`/`Set.Icc` notation.
